why: Top-stage check, stage 4c 2026-10-18: Judicalex is a private firm ('gérant de la société') in a partnership with the Conakry commercial court. Only the hearing roll is said to be online. The decisions are 'numérisé', with no statement that they are published online. A firm's digitisation project with a roll online is not court decisions published or a public case-status lookup.

Rebuild 2026-11-11: the NHRC's 2024 report says the Judiciary has developed a case management system; the Court Automated System in six courts is transcription. The Office of the Chief Justice called the system a pilot in August 2024 and the Chief Justice still awaited its implementation in January 2026, so it is piloted, not in service.
